brief:
A rights organization has identified genocidal intent behind an assault on Hebron, according to the Electronic Intifada. Thousands of residents in the major West Bank city have been displaced from their homes or remain trapped inside them.

The group's assessment comes as the humanitarian crisis in Hebron deepens, with large portions of the civilian population unable to leave or return to their residences.
dek: Thousands displaced from or trapped inside homes in major West Bank city.
title: Rights group finds genocidal intent in Hebron assault
